p.src: 1  Again, on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before the LORD, Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD.

en: Again, on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before the LORD, Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD.
u.src: 1  Again, on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before the LORD, Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD.

p.src: 2  The LORD said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Satan answered the LORD, and said, “From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

ja: われた。「お前はどこから
en: The LORD said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Satan answered the LORD, and said, “From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”
u.src: 2  The LORD said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Satan answered the LORD, and said, “From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

p.src: 3  The LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil. He still maintains his integrity, although you incited me against him, to ruin him without cause.”

ja: われた。「お前は私のしもべヨブに
のように咎がなく正しい人、神を恐れて悪から遠ざかっている
させようと私をそそのかしたが、
en: The LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil. He still maintains his integrity, although you incited me against him, to ruin him without cause.”
u.src: 3  The LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil. He still maintains his integrity, although you incited me against him, to ruin him without cause.”

p.src: 4  Satan answered the LORD, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.

ja: つすべてのものを与えます。
en: Satan answered the LORD, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.
u.src: 4  Satan answered the LORD, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.

p.src: 5  But stretch out your hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will renounce you to your face.”

ja: はきっと、面と向かってあなたに背くでしょう。」
en: But stretch out your hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will renounce you to your face.”
u.src: 5  But stretch out your hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will renounce you to your face.”

p.src: 6  The LORD said to Satan, “Behold, he is in your hand. Only spare his life.”

en: The LORD said to Satan, “Behold, he is in your hand. Only spare his life.”
u.src: 6  The LORD said to Satan, “Behold, he is in your hand. Only spare his life.”

p.src: 7  So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.

en: So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.
u.src: 7  So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.

p.src: 8  He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.

ja: ヨブは身をかくために
en: He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.
u.src: 8  He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.

p.src: 9  Then his wife said to him, “Do you still maintain your integrity? Renounce God, and die.”

en: Then his wife said to him, “Do you still maintain your integrity? Renounce God, and die.”
u.src: 9  Then his wife said to him, “Do you still maintain your integrity? Renounce God, and die.”

p.src: 10  But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this Job didn’t sin with his lips.

ja: たちが口にするように語っている。何ということか。
けるべきではないか。」 このすべてのことにおいて、ヨブはその
en: But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this Job didn’t sin with his lips.
u.src: 10  But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this Job didn’t sin with his lips.

p.src: 11  Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and to comfort him.

ja: は、彼に降りかかったこのすべての災いについて聞き、それぞれ自分の所からやって来た。すなわち、テマン
らは彼をいたわり、慰めるために、一緒に来ることを打ち合わせていた。
en: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and to comfort him.
u.src: 11  Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and to comfort him.

p.src: 12  When they lifted up their eyes from a distance, and didn’t recognize him, they raised their voices, and wept; and they each tore his robe, and sprinkled dust on their heads toward the sky.

ja: けられなかった。彼らは
の上にちりを振りかけた。
en: When they lifted up their eyes from a distance, and didn’t recognize him, they raised their voices, and wept; and they each tore his robe, and sprinkled dust on their heads toward the sky.
u.src: 12  When they lifted up their eyes from a distance, and didn’t recognize him, they raised their voices, and wept; and they each tore his robe, and sprinkled dust on their heads toward the sky.

p.src: 13  So they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that his grief was very great.

en: So they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that his grief was very great.
